title: 4 nabbed in Navotas, Caloocan for ‘offering’ minors to foreigners
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Four individuals were arrested in two separate operations in Navotas and Caloocan City for allegedly offering Filipino minors to foreign nationals for sexual services through…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Four individuals were arrested in two separate operations in Navotas and Caloocan City for allegedly offering Filipino minors to foreign nationals for sexual services through online platforms. In an interview on Tuesday, NBI Human Trafficking Division Chief SA Rosalie Laguardia said the apprehensions were conducted at a resort in Navotas and in Caloocan City. “May bagong modus itong mga local facilitator natin. Hindi na ginagawa sa bahay nila ’yung online service. Nagre-renta sila ng either sa hotel or ’yung Airbnb para hindi ma-identify ’yung location nila, o ’yung bahay nila,” Laguardia said.
